collection.title: VIIRS/NPP Thermal Anomalies/Fire 6-Min L2 Swath 750m V002
collection.summary: The delivery of all Suomi National Polar-orbiting Partnership (Suomi NPP) VIIRS science data products [ceased on November 2, 2026 (2026/306)](https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/data/alerts-outages/reminder-new-suomi-npp-observations-cease-november-2-2026). Data users are encouraged to transition to the equivalent [VJ214](https://doi.org/10.5067/VIIRS/VJ214.002) (primary) or [VJ114](https://doi.org/10.5067/VIIRS/VJ114.002) (secondary) data products. The Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite (VIIRS) Thermal Anomalies (VNP14) Version 2 product is produced in 6-minute temporal satellite increments (swaths) at 750 meter resolution from the VIIRS sensor located on the NASA/NOAA Suomi National Polar-orbiting Partnership (Suomi NPP) satellite. This product is designed after the Terra and Aqua Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) Thermal Anomalies and Fire data products to promote the continuity of the Earth Observation System (EOS) mission. This data product can enable users to understand the location and intensity of fire events as well as identifying thermal anomalies. The VNP14 product includes 31 science dataset variables to analyze key factors in fire detection, including atmospheric conditions (e.g., atmospheric reflectance, solar zenith angle, brightness temperature) and fuel type for the event. The fire mask layer in the VNP14 product is the primary layer and can be used to identify fires and other thermal anomalies such as volcanoes. In addition to the fire mask, brightness temperature is provided for VIIRS channels M5, M7, M11, M13, M15, and M16. Each swath of data is approximately 3,060 kilometers along track (long) and 3,060 kilometers across track (wide). The VNP14 product is also used to generate higher-level fire data products. Use of the [VNP03MODLL](https://doi.org/10.5067/viirs/vnp03modll.002) data product is required to apply accurate geolocation information to the VNP14 Science Datasets (SDS) / Variables. Known Issues * For complete information about known issues please refer to the [MODIS/VIIRS Land Quality Assessment website](https://landweb.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/knownissue?sensor=VIIRS).

documentation.description: The LDOPE Land Product Quality Assessment website provides known issues, maneuvers, and product quality of the land products.
The technical information in the User's Guide enables users to interpret and use the data products.
The ATBD provides physical theory and mathematical procedures for the calculations used to produce the data products.
The File Specification provides a description of the product file including Scientific Data Sets and their attributes.
Validation at stage 1 has been achieved for the VIIRS Active Fire product suite.
Further details regarding VIIRS product validation and maturity status are available from VIIRS Land Product Quality Assessment site.
